issues.title: Loan Simple leads receiving duplicate tasks in post-referral and other workflows
issues.desc: HAs and TCs were receiving double tasks for Loan Simple leads across multiple workflows including post-referral and pre-referral. The issue was caused by a bugged filter related to Loan Simple lead associations in HubSpot. Madelaine worked with HubSpot support to resolve it.
issues.workaround: Review any LS leads that received duplicate tasks during the impact window and manually close out the duplicate tasks.

issues.title: Offer Accepted workflow not re-enrolling deals that toggled back from a prior stage
issues.desc: When a deal was marked Offer Accepted, then reverted to a prior stage (e.g. Committed), and then moved back to Offer Accepted again, the TC workflow and associated tasks did not re-trigger. The root cause was that 'deal stage = Offer Accepted' was missing from the workflow's re-enrollment criteria. Madelaine updated the re-enrollment criteria to fix this going forward.
issues.workaround: Manually enroll any deals that toggled back and forth through Offer Accepted during the impact window to ensure TCs receive the correct tasks.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow tasks continuing after deal marked Closed Lost or Transferred
issues.desc: HAs were receiving post-referral workflow check-in tasks even after deals had been marked as Closed Lost or Transferred. The workflow was not properly suppressing or unenrolling deals with terminal statuses. Madelaine made a tweak to the workflow filters on March 9th to address this.
issues.workaround: Manually dismiss any erroneous check-in tasks received for deals already marked Closed Lost or Transferred during the impact window.

issues.title: Automated emails sending with previous loan officer's information after LO change
issues.desc: After a loan officer change on a deal, automated emails continued to reference the old LO rather than the newly assigned one. The correct LO was reflected in Dash but not in HubSpot workflow-triggered emails. Luis investigated and resolved the issue.
issues.workaround: Manually resend any automated emails to agents or clients that went out with the incorrect LO information during the impact window.

issues.title: Post-referral workflow not triggering tasks for referrals accepted after March 18th
issues.desc: HAs were not receiving any workflow tasks for referrals made and accepted starting around March 18th. The root cause was an error with how data was being pulled, which prevented the workflow from filtering correctly. The issue was escalated to the product team for resolution.
issues.workaround: Manually enroll any deals accepted between February 26th and April 1st into the post-referral workflow to ensure all tasks are generated.

issues.title: Buyer credit SMS sent in Offer Accepted stage before closing info available, missing credit amount
issues.desc: An SMS notifying buyers of their credit amount was firing in the Offer Accepted stage, before closing information had been submitted and the credit amount could be calculated. The SMS should only send during the Sale Pending stage with the dollar amount populated. The issue was identified as a Dash-triggered communication rather than a HubSpot workflow, and was escalated to the product team.
issues.workaround: Manually send the buyer credit SMS with the correct credit amount to any buyers who received the incomplete SMS during the Offer Accepted stage in the impact window.
